tokens.attribution_note: Phase 2 generation and first-pass audit share one closed researcher turn; telemetry is retained at turn granularity. No repair turn is included.

source_revision.method: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 list of sorted relative paths paired with per-file SHA-256 values; node_modules and dist directories excluded.

source_availability.reason: The generated source changes were reverted after first-pass capture; this receipt preserves the closed-turn telemetry and historical first-pass hash without claiming the current tree matches.

context_isolation.reason: The frozen UC-08a Business Rule expressions were loaded only after first-pass generation ended and its source fingerprint was captured.

restoration_basis: Recreated from the original closed Codex session telemetry and the previously captured first-pass hash after accidental artifact deletion.
